summary: Mock / illustrative evidence supports connection pressure more strongly than a query/index regression.

sections.title: Connection Pressure

facts.text: Connection utilization increased from 25% to 92% and mock connection failures were present.
Request p95 increased from 220 ms to 1100 ms (400%).
The query plan remained IXSCAN and scan efficiency stayed approximately stable.

hypothesis.text: Hypothesis: connection saturation is a better-supported explanation than a query/index regression.

recommendedChecks: Inspect client pool sizing and checkout wait time.
Correlate connection failures with the latency window.
limitations: Mock / illustrative data cannot identify which client exhausted connections.
All values are mock / illustrative; replace mock adapters for production evidence.
